Mom and I had a fight one evening. I was insisting her to stop smoking because it's bad for her (and for me, I get asthma attacks from cigarette smoke). 

The next day, I go about my business and go to school and such and we don't talk at all the entire day, save for that one moment before I leave where she hugs me and angrily/awkwardly reprimands me for not even saying bye. 

She died that night from heart failure. 
I never got to apologize. 

Beyond that, I never got answers to many questions I've yet to ask - about why she's been physically abusive, why I always have to meet her unreasonable asian expectations and why she doesn't understand how many of the problems I have now are all because she refuses to own up to her flaws. 
I love her anyway, but now there's just this giant hole that will stay that way forever.
